outlook.statement: Company remains optimistic about growth trajectory with all business segments expected to contribute positively to topline growth and profitability in FY 2026-2027 and beyond. Refractory Division to benefit from continued expansion of India's steelmaking capacity and robust domestic demand. Export market penetration expected to increase but geopolitical uncertainties and elevated freight costs may lead to muted demand in short term. Oil & Gas Division expected to benefit from continued upstream activity and selective investments in exploration and production.

India's economic outlook remains favourable, supported by resilient domestic consumption, favourable demographics, rising infrastructure investments, expanding manufacturing capabilities and continued structural reforms. While geopolitical uncertainties, global trade fragmentation, commodity price volatility and evolving trade policies may pose challenges.

India expected to remain one of the fastest-growing major economies with healthy economic activity supported by sustained public capex, increasing private investments, favourable demographics and continued emphasis on digitalisation and industrial development

Steel industry and allied sectors including refractories and ceramic raw materials expected to benefit from India's expanding infrastructure, construction, engineering and manufacturing sectors with progress towards higher domestic steelmaking capacity
Ceramic Raw Materials business expected to benefit from increasing domestic manufacturing, higher mineral value addition and import substitution initiatives

Specialty Ceramics long-term outlook remains encouraging with increasing investment in upstream oil and gas exploration and unconventional reservoir development supporting demand for high-performance ceramic proppants
Company committed to strengthening market position through continuous investment in R&D, product innovation, technology upgradation and sustainable manufacturing practices
